newsitem.title: UK: IPE natgas ticks up in front months, OTC stays sof.
newsitem.headline: IPE natgas ticks up in front months, OTC stays sof.

text.p: IPE natural gas futures were quiet again on Tuesday afternoon, with only two trades done, one each in July and September. A total of 20 lots traded.

Both deals were done at stronger prices. "That doesn't sit consistently with the OTC market," said a futures broker, pointing out that the bid/offer spread for the third quarter on the physical market on Tuesday afternoon was 10.25/10.40 pence a therm.
"Figures of 10.50 and 10.70 (the prices on futures for July and September) don't really fit in with that," he said.
Bids and offers were generally few and far between on Tuesday, although bids were seen on 10 of the 12 contract months, and offers on 11, by the close.

Dealers said that most signals on the physical market, including the settlement of various litigation in the North Sea concerning Enron, and the tender for Balancing Margins gas to be sold by Transco over the summer, were bearish. This made it more surprising that prices had ticked up on the front months on futures.
